name: shove
description: Shove/drag a player or corpse into an adjacent room via a contested brawn-vs-weight check.

shove.note: KNOWN GAP: targets a player/NPC/corpse/sleeper and shoves them through a directional exit. NPC/player examine only prints talk+attack; directional, no tag anchor.

drag.note: KNOWN GAP: alias of shove; same target/direction gating and same discoverability gap.
